adventure.name: The Beginner's Cave
adventure.description: A simple cavern for new adventurers to test their mettle. Many have entered. Some have returned.
adventure.style_prompt_prefix: Eyvind Earle Sleeping Beauty 1959 style, geometric angular Gothic architecture, jewel-tone palette of deep purples and midnight blues with burnished gold accents, Byzantine and Persian miniature influence, architectural depth with layered planes, painterly backgrounds with light-defined detail, flat graphic characters with subtle shading, Celtic ornamental details
adventure.author: Donald Brown
adventure.intro: You stand at the entrance to a cave. A sign over the entrance reads "Beginners Only!" Your heart quickens as you grip your weapon. Whatever lies within, fame and fortune await the brave — or a quick death awaits the foolish.

locations.name: Cave Entrance
locations.narration_text: The entrance is to the south with a sign over it reading, "Beginners Only!". To the north is the road back to town.
locations.background_description: The entrance is to the south with a sign over it reading, "Beginners Only!". To the north is the road back to town.

locations.name: Dark North/South Tunnel
locations.narration_text: To the north you see bright light streaming in from the outside. To the south you see flickering torch light, but you cannot make out any details.
locations.background_description: To the north you see bright light streaming in from the outside. To the south you see flickering torch light, but you cannot make out any details.

locations.name: West Side Chamber
locations.narration_text: It is very cold here and the only light comes in dimly from the large chamber to the east.
locations.background_description: It is very cold here and the only light comes in dimly from the large chamber to the east.

locations.name: Large Chamber
locations.narration_text: You are in a huge chamber where the roof rises out of sight. Burning torches line the walls making it easy to see. Tunnels lead north and south, and there are small chambers to the east and west.
locations.background_description: You are in a huge chamber where the roof rises out of sight. Burning torches line the walls making it easy to see. Tunnels lead north and south, and there are small chambers to the east and west.

locations.name: East Side Chamber
locations.narration_text: It is very cold here and the only light comes in dimly from the large chamber to the west.
locations.background_description: It is very cold here and the only light comes in dimly from the large chamber to the west.

locations.name: West Cell
locations.narration_text: You are in a small stark cell with a door on the east side of the room.
locations.background_description: You are in a small stark cell with a door on the east side of the room.

locations.name: North End of Long Passage
locations.narration_text: A tunnel goes north and east and west are doors that are bolted shut. (Locking something in?) In the dim light you can see that the hall goes south but you cannot make out any details.
locations.background_description: A tunnel goes north and east and west are doors that are bolted shut. (Locking something in?) In the dim light you can see that the hall goes south but you cannot make out any details.

locations.name: East Cell
locations.narration_text: You are in a small stark cell with a door on the west side of the room.
locations.background_description: You are in a small stark cell with a door on the west side of the room.

locations.name: West Cell
locations.narration_text: You are in a small stark cell with a door on the east side. An inscription on the wall reads: "You can type GET ALL to pick up everything in the room. This will usually not pick up dead bodies or immovable objects."
locations.background_description: You are in a small stark cell with a door on the east side. An inscription on the wall reads: "You can type GET ALL to pick up everything in the room. This will usually not pick up dead bodies or immovable objects."

locations.name: Middle of Long Passage
locations.narration_text: Doors are bolted on both sides of you (east and west). The hall extends north and south.
locations.background_description: Doors are bolted on both sides of you (east and west). The hall extends north and south.

locations.name: East Cell
locations.narration_text: You are in a small stark cell with a door on the west side. An inscription reads: "Most commands can be abbreviated. AT DR is the same as ATTACK DRAGON. Commands are not case sensitive."
locations.background_description: You are in a small stark cell with a door on the west side. An inscription reads: "Most commands can be abbreviated. AT DR is the same as ATTACK DRAGON. Commands are not case sensitive."

locations.name: West Cell
locations.narration_text: You are in a small stark cell with a door on the east side.
locations.background_description: You are in a small stark cell with a door on the east side.

locations.name: South End of Long Passage
locations.narration_text: To your great shock there are doors to the east and west. The hall goes north from here and a broken tunnel goes south.
locations.background_description: To your great shock there are doors to the east and west. The hall goes north from here and a broken tunnel goes south.

locations.name: East Cell
locations.narration_text: You are in a small stark cell with a door on the west side. A large chest sits in the center of the room.
locations.background_description: You are in a small stark cell with a door on the west side. A large chest sits in the center of the room.

locations.name: Broken North/South Tunnel
locations.narration_text: The sides of the tunnel are very broken and rough. You see torch light to the south. The east wall has a smooth shape in the center, about the size of a door.
locations.background_description: The sides of the tunnel are very broken and rough. You see torch light to the south. The east wall has a smooth shape in the center, about the size of a door.

locations.name: Secret East/West Tunnel
locations.narration_text: You are in a secret east/west passage. You hear a faint melody coming from the east.
locations.background_description: You are in a secret east/west passage. You hear a faint melody coming from the east.

locations.name: East/West Tunnel with Loud Music
locations.narration_text: You can very clearly hear religious music being played and can smell incense from the east.
locations.background_description: You can very clearly hear religious music being played and can smell incense from the east.

locations.name: The Temple
locations.narration_text: You are in a temple that has paintings of great deeds covering the walls. There are two altars here, one covered with gold paint and the other stained with blood. The only exit leads to the west.
locations.background_description: You are in a temple that has paintings of great deeds covering the walls. There are two altars here, one covered with gold paint and the other stained with blood. The only exit leads to the west.

locations.name: The Library
locations.narration_text: You are in what was obviously once a library. Most of the books have been destroyed, with the scraps left lying on the ground. A door, torn from its hinges, also lies on the floor. The exit is to the east.
locations.background_description: You are in what was obviously once a library. Most of the books have been destroyed, with the scraps left lying on the ground. A door, torn from its hinges, also lies on the floor. The exit is to the east.

locations.name: T-Intersection
locations.narration_text: A brightly burning torch is bolted to the south wall. Dark tunnels lead north and east. To the west is a place where once a door stood, but it has been torn from its hinges.
locations.background_description: A brightly burning torch is bolted to the south wall. Dark tunnels lead north and east. To the west is a place where once a door stood, but it has been torn from its hinges.

locations.name: East/West Tunnel
locations.narration_text: You are in an unremarkable tunnel. You can see torch light in both directions. Writing on the wall reads: "To repeat the last command, just hit the Enter key. To recall previous commands, use the up and down arrow keys."
locations.background_description: You are in an unremarkable tunnel. You can see torch light in both directions. Writing on the wall reads: "To repeat the last command, just hit the Enter key. To recall previous commands, use the up and down arrow keys."

locations.name: Top of Stairway
locations.narration_text: You are at an unremarkable stone landing at the top of a flight of stairs. A single torch is bolted to the wall. A tunnel heads back west. It looks very dark down there...
locations.background_description: You are at an unremarkable stone landing at the top of a flight of stairs. A single torch is bolted to the wall. A tunnel heads back west. It looks very dark down there...

locations.name: Bottom of Stairway
locations.narration_text: You are at an unremarkable stone landing at the bottom of a flight of stairs. A light can be seen at the top and a very dim light can be seen down the tunnel to the east.
locations.background_description: You are at an unremarkable stone landing at the bottom of a flight of stairs. A light can be seen at the top and a very dim light can be seen down the tunnel to the east.

locations.name: Rough Tunnel
locations.narration_text: You are in a very rough tunnel carved out of a series of natural caverns. Dim light can be seen in both directions. An inscription reads: "Interesting items are sometimes hidden within room descriptions. Try looking at unusual features — rough walls, cracks, bookshelves."
locations.background_description: You are in a very rough tunnel carved out of a series of natural caverns. Dim light can be seen in both directions. An inscription reads: "Interesting items are sometimes hidden within room descriptions. Try looking at unusual features — rough walls, cracks, bookshelves."

locations.name: Tunnel Smelling of Salt
locations.narration_text: You see light to the east, and feel a cool wind coming from there. In the wind you smell a hint of salt.
locations.background_description: You see light to the east, and feel a cool wind coming from there. In the wind you smell a hint of salt.

locations.name: The Pirate's Cove
locations.narration_text: You are at a small bay. Cliffs rise on either side of you so that the only exit is back in the tunnel to the west. A broken old boat is resting on the bank of the rough and stormy sea. All around you is salt water, as far as the eye can see.
locations.background_description: You are at a small bay. Cliffs rise on either side of you so that the only exit is back in the tunnel to the west. A broken old boat is resting on the bank of the rough and stormy sea. All around you is salt water, as far as the eye can see.

characters.name: Rat
characters.description: You see three huge rats charging at you! One is black, one is brown, and one is tan. Each one has sharp white teeth.
characters.first_encounter_text: You see three huge rats charging at you! One is black, one is brown, and one is tan. Each one has sharp white teeth.
characters.portrait_description: Three oversized cave rats with sharp white teeth, one black, one brown, and one tan, charging low through dim torchlight in Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.

characters.name: Priest
characters.description: A huge man in religious garb with an insane look on his face. In his right hand, he carries a heavy mace.
characters.first_encounter_text: A huge man in religious garb with an insane look on his face. In his right hand, he carries a heavy mace.
characters.portrait_description: Huge wild-eyed priest in heavy religious garb gripping a mace, dramatic angular silhouette, Eyvind Earle Sleeping Beauty 1959 style.

characters.name: Cynthia
characters.description: A beautiful girl in a flowing white dress. You recognize her as Cynthia Luxom, Duke Luxom's not-too-bright daughter.
characters.first_encounter_text: A beautiful girl in a flowing white dress. You recognize her as Cynthia Luxom, Duke Luxom's not-too-bright daughter.
characters.portrait_description: Beautiful young noblewoman in a flowing white dress, innocent expression, jewel-tone shadows and Celtic ornamental trim, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.

characters.name: Hermit
characters.description: A grizzled old hermit who smells as if he hasn't taken a bath in forty years.
characters.first_encounter_text: A grizzled old hermit who smells as if he hasn't taken a bath in forty years.
characters.portrait_description: Grizzled old hermit with tangled hair and weathered clothes, carrying an axe, wary neutral stance, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.

characters.name: Gorilla
characters.description: A huge, hairy, strong and angry gorilla!
characters.first_encounter_text: A huge, hairy, strong and angry gorilla!
characters.portrait_description: Huge angry gorilla with heavy shoulders and clenched fists, dark fur against dim cavern light, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.

characters.name: Heinrich
characters.description: A human warrior armed with a longsword and carrying a shield. On his shield is a sticker which says, "Hi, I'm Heinrich!"
characters.first_encounter_text: A human warrior armed with a longsword and carrying a shield. On his shield is a sticker which says, "Hi, I'm Heinrich!"
characters.portrait_description: Human warrior with longsword and shield bearing a Hi, I am Heinrich sticker, neutral mercenary expression, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.

characters.name: Mimic
characters.description: A chest-shaped monster holding you with two tentacles and attempting to disassemble you with a third one.
characters.first_encounter_text: A chest-shaped monster holding you with two tentacles and attempting to disassemble you with a third one.
characters.portrait_description: Chest-shaped monster with grasping tentacles and jagged lid-mouth, lurking in dim cell shadows, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.

characters.name: Pirate
characters.description: A man with a beard and a brass ring in his ear, wearing clothes made of silk, wielding a fancily engraved sword called TrollsFire.
characters.first_encounter_text: A man with a beard and a brass ring in his ear, wearing clothes made of silk, wielding a fancily engraved sword called TrollsFire.
characters.portrait_description: Bearded pirate with brass earring and silk clothes, wielding an ornate sword named TrollsFire, windswept cove backdrop, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.

items.name: diamonds
items.description: A large pile of gleaming diamonds.

items.name: healing potion
items.description: A bottle with a strange potion inside. A label is stuck to it.

items.name: sack of coins
items.description: A sack with 50 gold coins inside!

items.name: spices
items.description: Several spices of a rare variety — quite valuable.

items.name: glowing book
items.description: An old book that glows in the darkness, remarkably well preserved.
items.text: The book contains ancient lore about the cave's history. It is of great scholarly value.
items.effect_description: Readable lore item; contains ancient scholarship about the cave.

items.name: TrollsFire
items.description: A beautiful sword. Carved on the hilt, in intricate detail, is the sword's name: "TrollsFire".
